from pathlib import Path
import contextlib, io, json, sys, threading, unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
ROOT=Path('/home/grf/Desktop/Codex_Verification_Experiment_2026-11-07/codex_verification_v2')
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'harness'),str(ROOT/'tests')]
import runner,evaluate,run_concurrency_override as driver
from test_v2 import V2Tests,valid_call

class OverrideTests(unittest.TestCase):
 def setUp(self):
  self.fixture=V2Tests();self.fixture.setUp();self.root=self.fixture.root
  self.pe=patch.object(evaluate,'R',self.root);self.pe.start()
  self.frozen=self.fixture.prepare_freeze()
  self.amend={'schema_version':1,'kind':'dispatch_concurrency_only','from_max_workers':3,'to_max_workers':12,'workers':12,
   'baseline_frozen_sha256':runner.file_sha(self.root/'protocol/frozen.json'),'driver_sha256':runner.file_sha(driver.DRIVER),
   'prior_terminal_records':{},'created_utc':'offline','authorization':'offline mock'}
  runner.dump(self.root/driver.AMENDMENT,self.amend)
 def tearDown(self):self.pe.stop();self.fixture.tearDown()
 def test_only_guard_changes_and_original_verify_identity_remains(self):
  cloned=driver.clone_run()
  changed={k for k in runner.run.__globals__ if cloned.__globals__[k] is not runner.run.__globals__[k]}
  self.assertEqual(changed,{'MAX_WORKERS'})
  self.assertEqual(runner.MAX_WORKERS,3)
  self.assertEqual(runner.execution_config()['max_workers'],3)
  self.assertIs(cloned.__globals__['verify'],runner.verify)
  self.assertIs(cloned.__globals__['response_task'],runner.response_task)
  self.assertTrue(driver.run(verify_only=True))
  self.fixture.cli.write_text('changed runtime')
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,'CLI identity'):driver.run(verify_only=True)
 def test_twelve_workers_full_first_pass_then_zero_resampling(self):
  barrier=threading.Barrier(12);guard=threading.Lock();calls=[0];active=[0];peak=[0]
  def call(cmd,**kw):
   with guard:calls[0]+=1;number=calls[0];active[0]+=1;peak[0]=max(peak[0],active[0])
   if number<=12:barrier.wait(timeout=5)
   result=valid_call(cmd,**kw)
   with guard:active[0]-=1
   return result
  with patch.object(runner.subprocess,'run',side_effect=call) as mock,contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
   self.assertTrue(driver.run('P0'))
  self.assertEqual(mock.call_count,160);self.assertEqual(peak[0],12)
  before={str(p):runner.file_sha(p) for p in (self.root/'runs/dev').glob('*/P0/record.json')}
  with patch.object(runner.subprocess,'run',side_effect=AssertionError('no resampling')) as mock,contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
   self.assertTrue(driver.run('P0'))
  mock.assert_not_called();self.assertEqual(before,{str(p):runner.file_sha(p) for p in (self.root/'runs/dev').glob('*/P0/record.json')})
  events=[json.loads(l) for l in (self.root/'runs/dev/progress.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
  self.assertTrue(any(e.get('event')=='invocation_started' and e['workers']==12 for e in events))
  self.assertTrue(any(e.get('event')=='concurrency_amendment_invocation' for e in events))
 def test_unknown_tasks_and_manifest_change_rejected(self):
  path=self.root/'runs/dev/unknown/P0/record.json';path.parent.mkdir(parents=True);path.write_text('{}')
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,'Unplanned run artifacts'):driver.run(verify_only=True)
 def test_prior_final_inventory_is_required_and_hash_checked(self):
  job=next(j for j in self.frozen['phase_schedule']['dev']['jobs'] if j['procedure']=='P0')
  item=next(i for i in runner.load_items() if i['item_id']==job['item_id'])
  with patch.object(runner.subprocess,'run',side_effect=valid_call):runner.response_task('dev',job,item,None,self.amend['baseline_frozen_sha256'])
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,'inventory every'):driver.run(verify_only=True)
  path=self.root/f"runs/dev/{job['group_id']}/P0/record.json"
  self.amend['prior_terminal_records']={str(path.relative_to(self.root)):runner.file_sha(path)}
  runner.dump(self.root/driver.AMENDMENT,self.amend)
  self.assertTrue(driver.run(verify_only=True))
  path.write_text('{}')
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,'Prior terminal record changed'):driver.run(verify_only=True)
 def test_amendment_scope_and_driver_hash_checked(self):
  for key,value in [('driver_sha256','bad'),('baseline_frozen_sha256','bad'),('workers',8),('to_max_workers',8)]:
   runner.dump(self.root/driver.AMENDMENT,{**self.amend,key:value})
   with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,'identity or scope'):driver.run(verify_only=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
 buffer=io.StringIO()
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buffer):
  result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=buffer,verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(OverrideTests))
 report={'utc':runner.now(),'offline_only':True,'real_model_calls':0,'tests_run':result.testsRun,'passed':result.wasSuccessful(),
 'failures':len(result.failures),'errors':len(result.errors),'driver_sha256':runner.file_sha(driver.DRIVER),
 'test_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'output':buffer.getvalue()}
 runner.dump(ROOT/'audits/concurrency_override_tests.json',report)
 print(json.dumps({k:report[k] for k in ['tests_run','passed','failures','errors','real_model_calls','driver_sha256']}))
 if not result.wasSuccessful():print(buffer.getvalue());raise SystemExit(1)
